name: score-v2
description: The speed gate's workload (SWARM-PACK.md, 'The score'): the geometric mean of two parts' single-thread QPS, each at the smallest beam whose recall@10 reaches 0.95 with the default vamana-int8 configuration, over all base vectors and the first 2,000 held-out queries. The parts are code-voyagecode4-200k (arko_index chunks of 12 code checkouts in arko_index's 8 languages, voyage-code-4) and docs-voyage4-200k (Cloudflare and MDN documentation, voyage-4), both 1024 dimensions (docs/datasets.md). Frozen: changing this file changes the score's identity.
